title: Norms, overlaps and Yangian descendants for the Haldane--Shastry spin chain
authors: Yunfeng Jiang, Jules Lamers, Yuan Miao
abstract: The Haldane-Shastry spin chain is a prototypical integrable model with long-range interactions, notable for hosting quasiparticles with fractional statistics and serving as a discrete analogue of a conformal field theory. Its remarkable simplicity is closely tied to a full Yangian spin symmetry. While the highest-weight states for this symmetry are known explicitly, a systematic treatment of the descendant states, needed for the computation of various physical quantities, has remained incomplete. In this work, we provide a detailed construction of these descendants in terms of the algebraic Bethe ansatz following recent work of Ferrando et al. In the limit of extreme twist, it includes the Gelfand-Tsetlin basis. As an application, we derive product and determinant formulae for norms and overlaps of these states.
summary: The paper tackles the complex problem of characterizing all eigenstates, not just the highest-weight states, within the Yangian symmetry framework of the Haldane–Shastry spin chain. By developing systematic methods using algebraic Bethe ansatz and determinant formulas, it provides explicit formulae for the norms and overlaps of these descendant states. This advances the theoretical understanding of integrable quantum many-body systems with long-range interactions.
main_problem: The primary goal is to systematically construct an orthogonal eigenbasis for the Yangian descendant states of the Haldane–Shastry (HS) spin chain and compute their norms and overlaps.
main_result: Product and determinant formulae are derived for the norms and overlaps of these descendant states, establishing a complete understanding of the spectral structure beyond the highest-weight states.
method: The analysis employs advanced techniques from the Algebraic Bethe Ansatz (ABA), leveraging connections to spin-Calogero–Sutherland systems and utilizing Jack polynomials and determinant formulas (Gaudin/Slavnov).
model_or_system: The system is the Haldane–Shastry (HS) spin chain, an integrable model with long-range interactions, which serves as a discrete analogue of a conformal field theory. Its integrability is governed by full Yangian symmetry.
key_observables: Norms and overlaps of descendant states ($\langle u|uangle$, $\langle v|uangle$), energy spectrum $E(\mu)$, and the structure of Yangian multiplets labeled by motifs $\mu$.
important_parameters: The twist parameter $\kappa$ (analyzed in limits like $\kappa=1$ for $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ symmetry, and $\kappa 	o \infty$ for the Gelfand–Tsetlin basis).
main_assumptions: The derivation relies on the completeness of the ABA framework and specific mathematical identities related to Jack polynomials.
figures_summary: Figures illustrate the structure of Yangian multiplets, showing descendant towers in both the extreme twist (GT) limit and the periodic ($\kappa=1$) limit, analogous to known spin chain structures.
paper_structure: The paper reviews existing knowledge on HS symmetry, details the connection to spin-CS systems via freezing limits, constructs the descendant states using ABA techniques, and concludes by deriving explicit formulas for norms and overlaps.
why_interesting: This work provides deep spectral information about an integrable quantum many-body system whose structure is governed by infinite symmetries (Yangian), which is crucial for understanding non-equilibrium dynamics in 1D quantum systems.
